sections.Profile:
"Skipper" is a nautical-themed electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in November 1969. Designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Art Stenholm, it accommodates up to four players.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1969
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Boats, Water Sports, Sports, Original Theme, Water
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Art Stenholm
- Design: Ed Krynski
